test_case_name: Accept All Cookies on Business Needs Page via Parent Menu Navigation

intents.intent: Click 'Business' in the main menu on the parent page
Click 'Acconsento' to accept all cookies on the child page
And then check that the cookie consent banner is dismissed on the child page

test_case_name: Open Cookie Policy Options from Business Needs Section via Parent Menu

intents.intent: Click 'Business' in the main menu on the parent page
Click 'Più opzioni' to open the cookie policy on the child page
And then check that the Privacy - Cookie policy page is displayed

test_case_name: Search for Information on Business Needs Page via Desktop Search

intents.intent: Click 'Business' in the main menu on the parent page
Type $name in the 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' search input on the child page
Click the 'btn-search' button to submit the search on the child page
And then check that the search results are displayed for $name

test_case_name: Reset Desktop Search on Business Needs Page via Parent Navigation

intents.intent: Click 'Business' in the main menu on the parent page
Type $name in the 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' search input on the child page
Click the 'btn-reset-search' button to clear the search input on the child page
And then check that the search input is empty

test_case_name: Perform Mobile Search on Business Needs Page via Parent Menu

intents.intent: Click 'Business' in the main menu on the parent page

test_case_name: Login as Guest on Business Needs Page via Parent Menu

intents.intent: Click 'Business' in the main menu on the parent page
Click 'Accesso clienti' to open the login panel on the child page
Type $email in the 'E-mail' input on the child page
Type $name in the 'Password' input on the child page
Click 'ENTRA' to submit the login form on the child page
And then check that the user is logged in as a guest
